carousels.title: Housing Affordability on the Rise
carousels.caption: Good news for homebuyers! Housing affordability is improving as wage growth outpaces home price increases. Dive in to see what this means for you. #HousingMarket #AffordableHomes #SafeTrustMortgage
carousels.hero_sub: Your earning power is growing faster than home values, making homeownership more accessible.
carousels.problem_sub: Many assume home prices are always skyrocketing out of reach, but the market is shifting.
carousels.solution_heading: Wages Gain Ground on Home Prices
carousels.solution_sub: National data shows that average wage increases are now exceeding the growth in home prices, improving affordability.
carousels.quote: Your income's purchasing power is strengthening in today's housing market.

carousels.details_sub: This trend creates a more stable and encouraging landscape for both first-time buyers and those looking to move up.

carousels.title: New Housing Act Becomes Law
carousels.caption: The 21st Century ROAD to Housing Act is now law! This legislation aims to cut red tape and make homeownership more attainable. Discover how this could benefit you. #HousingLegislation #HomeownershipDreams #SafeTrustMortgage
carousels.hero_sub: The 21st Century ROAD to Housing Act is designed to streamline processes and open up new avenues for buying a home.
carousels.problem_sub: Complex regulations and limited housing options have historically made homeownership a difficult goal for many.
carousels.solution_sub: This new legislation aims to simplify the path to homeownership by reducing regulatory burdens and fostering innovation in housing.
carousels.quote: The ROAD to Housing Act clears obstacles, making homeownership more attainable and diverse.

features.label: Reduced Bureaucracy
features.desc: Expect a more streamlined process in various aspects of home buying and development.

features.label: Increased Attainability
features.desc: The goal is to make homeownership a more realistic option for a wider range of buyers.

features.label: Innovative Housing
features.desc: New designs for manufactured homes could lead to more affordable and diverse housing choices.

features.label: Lower Financing Paths
features.desc: Potential for new, more cost-effective financing options for certain housing types.

carousels.details_sub: This act broadens the scope of what's possible in the housing market, offering more paths to secure your dream home.

steps.title: Stay Informed
steps.desc: Keep up with how these new regulations are implemented and impact local markets.

steps.title: Consider All Options
steps.desc: Be open to exploring different housing types, including manufactured homes, which may see new benefits.

steps.title: Review Your Eligibility
steps.desc: Understand how new policies might affect your mortgage eligibility and options.

steps.title: Consult a Mortgage Expert
steps.desc: Talk to SafeTrust Mortgage to understand the latest financing opportunities and how the act may apply to you.

carousels.cta_sub: New laws are paving the way for easier homeownership. Let SafeTrust Mortgage guide you.

carousels.title: Existing-Home Sales in June
carousels.caption: Existing-home sales eased slightly in June but remain above last year's levels. What does this 'sideways trend' mean for you as a buyer or seller? Let's break it down. #HousingMarketUpdate #HomeSales #SafeTrustMortgage
carousels.hero_heading: Home Sales Find a New Rhythm
carousels.hero_sub: Existing-home sales experienced a slight dip in June, settling into a more consistent trend.
carousels.problem_sub: Many expect dramatic swings in the housing market, leading to uncertainty and hesitation.
carousels.solution_sub: Existing-home sales are showing a sideways trend, meaning less dramatic fluctuations and more predictability for buyers and sellers.
carousels.quote: The market is less volatile, offering a more stable environment for your housing decisions.

features.label: Consistent Activity
features.desc: Despite a slight dip, sales remain 2.8% above last year, indicating sustained demand.

features.label: Mortgage Rate Influence
features.desc: Modest changes in rates are influencing buyer activity, highlighting the importance of current rates.

features.label: Time to Plan
features.desc: A less volatile market allows for more thoughtful and less rushed decisions on buying or selling.

features.label: Informed Decisions
features.desc: Steady trends provide clearer data for assessing property values and future market direction.

carousels.details_sub: A 'back-and-forth' market suggests opportunities for strategic buyers who are prepared and informed.
